steps.title: Reproducible identity and harness
steps.acceptance: A fresh clone passes the backend regressions, runs every other test without a missing-directory error, leaves git status empty, builds with an identity that is independent of the checkout path and line-ending setting and binds every harness file, and prints that identity without compiling.

steps.title: Baseline
steps.acceptance: Every B4-12 metric has a baseline from the unchanged harness on the unmodified build: one smoke run, then three full series of 100 measured samples per metric. A baseline that uses the one-run allowance says so next to every number and is never presented as a formal 3 x 100 result.

steps.title: Experiments (15 working days, day-7 go/no-go)
steps.acceptance: A renderer is selected only if it renders all 259,800 sticker slots at full detail with the most complex animation at an average of at least 30 fps and a 99th-percentile frame time of at most 33.3 ms on the owner's machine.
